bends.note: B1, kept. The fold between panel 1/2 and flange 3/4 at 90.3 deg, outer skin. The line is 236.8 mm, from u -389 to -152, so it covers the whole fold. It sits on the apex in the close-up section.
B2, kept. The fold between flange 3/4 and jog strip 5/17 at 90.4 deg, outer skin (patch 3 normal +a, patch 5 normal -b). The line is 237.0 mm, full length, with a clean apex.

B3, amended: replaces 6-17. This is the full-length 90 deg fold between jog strip 5/17 and strip 6/7. The pair is inner skin: patch 5 (b 105.3, normal -b) and patch 7 (a 132.3, normal +a). Both are full length: patch 5 spans u -388 to -155 and patch 7 spans u -389 to -155. The outer skin cannot express this fold, because the +b face of strip 5 has no scan points from u -315 to -175; it faces into the closed channel. That face exists only as the 32 mm fragment 17 at the left end, so 6-17 gave a 32 mm line, about 14% coverage. The prep candidate list shows 5-7 as inner skin, 88.96 deg, 237.4 mm long, coverage 1.0.
B4, kept. The fold between strip 6/7 and the right-end foot 15 at 89.8 deg, outer skin. The line is 19.0 mm against a 18.4 mm foot.
B5, kept. The fold between strip 6/7 and the left-end foot 16/18 at 90.4 deg, outer skin. The line is 19.9 mm against a 19.7 mm foot.
B6, kept. The fold between flange 3/4 and the right-end tab 10/11 at 90.8 deg, outer skin. The line is 86.6 mm against a tab about 90 mm long (b 104.5 to 195), about 96% coverage.
